observed_result.summary: Revoke during a slow prepare denies child and parent and ignores the late Prepared; pending approvals cannot complete after a revoke; publish re-runs the production issuance::check and voids after revoke, cutoff, policy-revision change, budget expiry and TIME_UNCERTAIN; reserve refuses on the same predicates; a reservation found after restart stays counted and is never published; remote_pending and residual are truthful. Two ADR-0006 §13.5 rulings fail (gap cases). Gap fixes (M01-wave2-gapfix): an unrelated revoke re-validates healthy grants silently (ADR-0006 §13.5 ruling 2; the stale decision record is DECISION_STALE, the waiting operation stays waiting and gets a fresh decision_ref) while an ancestor revoke fails the chain; a delegated child holds a reference on its parent (ruling 1); permitted extensions come from the grant snapshot (ruling 3); every applicable policy's cutoff bounds the grant (G08); reserve/publish interleavings include wall-deadline passage and assert every void reason (G12).

limitations: Time uncertainty at delivery to the receiving signer is M03 (not modelled).
R-AU-04/R-SE-07 (A07 managed issuance, M03) are not claimed.

Re-validation readings chosen fail closed and escalated (M01-wave2-gapfix): a pause or cutoff touching the chain fails it; StandingPolicy/Delegation grants need Allowed on re-resolution, OwnerDecision grants need only not-denied; publish voids (StaleGeneration) when the generation moved since its reservation even for an unrelated change.

Status discipline (m01-plan E15): rows marked verified mean the indexed tests ran and passed on that platform in this run; there has been no independent review of the units (all stay implemented_unverified until review).

Linux and Windows binaries were cross-built on the macOS host with zig (glibc floor 2.31 / x86_64-windows-gnu) and executed natively on the hosts; proptest regression files (resolved at compile-time source paths) were not present on the remote hosts, so persisted regression seeds replayed only on macOS; default fixed seeds ran everywhere.
The second owner Linux host (labelled linux-b) refused ssh (tailnet policy denies the user; exit 255 before any build or copy), so Linux x86-64 evidence comes from one host (linux-a).
contracts (platform-neutral schema/golden-file checks) reads repository files at compile-time paths and ran on macOS only.

Every fake effect, clock and store in these tests is a disposable fixture (FakeCredentialAdapter, VirtualClock/ScriptedTimeSync, in-memory or temp-dir SQLite, owner-only sockets/pipes in temp dirs); no provider, network service or real key was used.
